title: ε-regularity at the origin for minimizing currents in ℝ^P (Allard 5.2 via Simon 7.1.2)
statement: Let P, j ∈ ℕ with 1 ≤ j ≤ P. Then there is a real δ > 0 with the following property. Let C ∈ 𝒟_j(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) j) be minimizing in ℝ^P (IsMinimizingIn C univ, Simon 7.1.1; in particular C is integer multiplicity), with ∂C = 0 (BoundaryVanishes C) and 0 ∈ spt C (C.support), and suppose M_{B_ρ(0)}(C) ≤ (1 + δ)·ω_j·ρ^j in [0, ∞] for every real ρ with 0 < ρ ≤ 1, i.e. C.massOn (ball 0 ρ) ≤ ofReal(1 + δ)·unitBallVolume j·ofReal(ρ^j); here B_ρ(0) is the open ball, M_W = massOn (Simon 6.2.5) and ω_j = unitBallVolume j is the Lebesgue measure of the unit ball of ℝ^j. Then 0 ∈ reg C (regularSet C, Simon 7.4.1 as in the contract: 0 ∈ spt C and there are ρ' > 0, m ∈ ℤ ∖ {0} and an embedded oriented C¹ j-submanifold M ∋ 0 of locally finite Hʲ-measure in B_{ρ'}(0) with C = m[[M]] in B_{ρ'}(0)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P j : ℕ), 1 ≤ j → j ≤ P → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) j, IsMinimizingIn C univ → BoundaryVanishes C → (0 : Euclid P) ∈ C.support → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ 1 → C.massOn (ball 0 ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 + δ) * unitBallVolume j * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ j)) → (0 : Euclid P) ∈ regularSet C
